source_claim: AlphaEvolve tracks model-call budgets, evaluation budgets, and fixed-budget ablations while operating an asynchronous search pipeline, so role-level LLM budget evidence must stay separate from queued or pending async work that has not been implemented.
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has cooperative llm_budget_report snapshots, runtime cooperative budget policy, role scheduler scope metadata, logical-call usage, retry-attempt usage, adapter-attempt usage, provider-token usage, configured cost usage, retained latency usage, controller budget-event replay, full-runtime restore budget pre-application, and resume artifact inventory checks. It does not claim async role work queue budget accounting, queued/running/pending-work budget state, hard provider cancellation budget state, provider-output replay for budget resume, accelerator or worker lease budget accounting, or experiment-owned quota policy.
